title: Senior GL Accountant (US Focus)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior GL Accountant to support US-focused accounting and finance operations within a fast-paced and high-performance environment.



The ideal candidate has strong experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting, with a solid understanding of US GAAP and multi-entity accounting operations.



This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are confident working independently, partnering cross-functionally, and operating within process-driven finance environments that value accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Who This Role Is For



We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting environments

• Multi-entity operations

• Cross-functional finance teams

• High-volume and fast-paced close cycles

• Process-driven accounting environments

• Roles requiring strong ownership and accountability



Role Overview



The Senior GL Accountant will take ownership of key accounting functions including:

• General ledger management

• Month-end and year-end close

• Financial reporting support

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Audit preparation and compliance

• Process improvement initiatives



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity reporting structures and cross-functional finance operations.



Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Close

• Own and manage assigned general ledger accounts

• Prepare and review journal entries including:

Accruals

Deferrals

Depreciation

Amortization

Reclassifications

Revenue and expense adjustments



• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities

• Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly

• Maintain accurate supporting schedules and audit-ready workpapers

• Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial records



Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Support preparation of monthly financial reports and supporting schedules

• Perform variance and flux analysis with clear explanations

• Assist with management reporting and ad hoc financial analysis

• Ensure proper cutoff and period-end accuracy



Technical Accounting & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies

• Support internal and external audit activities

• Maintain strong internal controls and documentation standards

• Review transactions for proper accounting treatment

• Assist in implementing accounting process improvements and best practices



Multi-Entity & Cross-Functional Support

• Support intercompany and multi-entity reconciliations

• Handle multi-currency transactions and FX adjustments

• Coordinate closely with AP, AR, Payroll, FP&A, and Operations teams

• Act as point of contact for assigned entities or business units



Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to streamline and improve accounting workflows

• Support close acceleration and accounting optimization initiatives

• Assist in documenting accounting procedures and SOPs

• Support ERP and finance system enhancement projects



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance

• Strong understanding of US GAAP

• Minimum 5+ years of progressive accounting experience

• Proven ownership of month-end close processes

• Strong experience with general ledger accounting and reconciliations

• Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite or similar preferred)

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational ability

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines effectively



Preferred Qualifications

• CPA or equivalent certification is a strong advantage

• Experience supporting US-based companies

• Multi-entity and intercompany accounting exposure

• SOX/internal controls experience is an advantage

• Public accounting background is a plus

• Experience mentoring or reviewing work of junior accountants is an advantage

• Experience working within high-growth or fast-paced environments is preferred



Application Instructions



To be considered for this position, please submit the following:



• Your application letter

• Unrestricted link to your updated resume/CV



Subject Line:



USSrGLAcct – YOUR FULL NAME



Only applicants who meet the required qualifications will be contacted.

• US accounting and finance environments

• AP/AR and finance operations roles

• Fast-paced and high-volume operations

• Ownership-driven environments with minimal handholding

• Roles requiring accountability, initiative, and problem-solving

• Cross-functional operational support

• Process improvement and issue resolution

The AP/AR Accountant – Finance Ops will support and take ownership of key accounting and finance functions including:

• Accounts Payable operations

• Accounts Receivable management

• Billing and invoicing

• Reconciliations and payment tracking

• Collections and issue resolution

• Financial operations support

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
# Amazon PPC Manager (Only Zest) — JD



**Location:** Remote, Philippines-based

**Type:** Full-time

**Salary:** $800 - $1,000 USD/month based on experience, BEFORE performance bonus

**Hours:** Mon-Fri 12pm-10pm SGT (GMT+8), 30 min lunch break. 44 hrs/week, 176 hrs/month.



---



Only Zest is a Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand selling paper-based consumer products. We're doing approximately 7-figures annualised on Amazon US, with 30+ active ASINs and ~$39K/month in ad spend.



We are scaling the Amazon side and need an Amazon PPC Manager to own, optimise, and scale our advertising across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display. You will work alongside our existing PPC operations and our AI Performance Director (Rex) who runs weekly portfolio analysis.



## Role overview

You will drive profitable growth using tools like Helium 10, Scale Insights, and DataDive, while building SOPs that make results repeatable. The single most important metric we're tracking: getting our TACoS down from 32% to 20% within 18 months by getting paid spend to compound into organic rank.



This is for a results-oriented operator who works with minimal supervision and wants to grow alongside a high-performing team.



## Key responsibilities

- Manage, optimise, and scale Amazon PPC campaigns across 30+ active ASINs to hit ACoS and TACoS targets

- Analyse performance metrics (CTR, CVR, ACoS, TACoS, ROAS) and present clear actionable insights

- Develop and execute keyword and targeting strategies (branded, competitor, category, PAT, defence)

- Use automation tools to streamline campaign optimisation and scaling

- Build and maintain SOPs for consistency, efficiency, and future team scaling

- Drive high-quality traffic efficiently to product listings to maximise ROI

- Familiarise yourself with SEO, listing optimisation, and keyword targeting so you know what to aim for

- Work alongside an AI Performance Director (Rex) that already runs weekly diagnostics, so you can focus on execution and judgement, not dashboard building



## What we are looking for

- **3 to 4 years** of hands-on Amazon PPC management with proven success in scaling campaigns

- Strong analytical mindset and deep understanding of Amazon advertising metrics

- Skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for performance tracking

- Familiarity with tools like Scale Insights, Helium 10, and DataDive

- Strategic thinker who can balance growth goals with daily optimisations

- Goal-oriented, proactive, comfortable working with minimal supervision

- **Fluent with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) as part of your daily workflow.** We use AI internally as a force multiplier and we want to see how you leverage it. Equally important: you can spot when AI is wrong and push back. We do not want AI sycophants.



## What you will bring

- A results-driven approach focused on profitable growth

- Clear communication and the ability to present insights simply

- Proactive problem-solving: you anticipate and fix issues early

- Passion for staying ahead of Amazon's evolving ad platform

- Team-oriented mindset, you want to build the company together



## Application instructions, read carefully

To be considered you must include all four of the following or your application will be skipped:

1. Put the word **AMAZON** at the very top of your reply

2. Your CV or resume

3. A short video introduction explaining why you are a great fit for this role

4. Your current status: why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing just before applying



Applications with video introductions will be prioritised. Applications missing any of the above will not be entertained.



We screen the application's screening questions HARD. Generic, AI-sounding, or vague answers are auto-rejected. We're only interested in candidates who can think and write specifically.



## Important note

This is not an entry-level position. If you are new to the workforce or lack relevant Amazon PPC experience, please do not apply.



## Stage 2 (for shortlisted candidates only) — AI Co-Pilot Test

A **single 60-minute live working session** over Zoom or Google Meet. We pay **US$10** on completion regardless of outcome.



How it works:

- We hand you a real anonymised OZ portfolio snapshot (30 ASINs, ad spend, ACoS, TACoS, inventory, CVR)

- Your job: identify the 3 biggest opportunities for next week

- **AI use is mandatory.** Use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, your choice. You must share your screen the entire time so we can see how you direct AI.

- At the end, you present your 3 opportunities. We ask follow-up questions, including: "Which AI suggestion did you reject and why?"



We're not testing whether you know PPC, we're testing how you think with AI as your co-pilot, what you catch that AI misses, and how you push back when AI is wrong. There is no preparation needed.



---



Best regards,

Jerald

Only Zest

Documentary Style & Aesthetic Requirements:

2 - Typography: Text and lower thirds must be strictly minimalist, using sterile, monospaced fonts accompanied by mechanical keystroke audio.



3 - Sound Design: You must rely exclusively on dark ambient tracks, low-frequency drones, and isolated foley, avoiding generic, upbeat YouTube music entirely.



4 - Pacing: The edit must manufacture tension by holding static shots, utilizing slow push-ins, and executing abrupt audio cuts to absolute silence for psychological dread.

title: Payroll specialist
description:
Position Summary 

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for managing and processing payroll accurately and on time while ensuring compliance with company policies, federal and state regulations, and payroll procedures. This role supports employees with payroll-related questions, maintains payroll records, coordinates with HR and scheduling departments, and assists with payroll reporting and audits. Essential Duties & Responsibilities 



Payroll Processing & Administration  

 Process employee payroll accurately and within scheduled deadlines. 

 Review and verify employee time records, timesheets, attendance, overtime, and paid time off (PTO). 

 Ensure payroll calculations are accurate, including regular hours, overtime, holiday pay, sick time, and applicable deductions. 

 Monitor missed punches, time discrepancies, and incomplete timesheets. 

 Work with scheduling and management teams to resolve payroll discrepancies promptly. 

 Maintain payroll records and employee payroll files. 



Compliance & Recordkeeping

 

 Ensure payroll compliance with federal, state, and local labor laws. 

 Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation and personal information. 

 Process garnishments, deductions, direct deposit changes, and payroll adjustments as needed. 

 Assist with workers' compensation and payroll-related documentation. 

 Support internal audits and compliance reviews. 

 Maintain records in accordance with company retention policies. 



Employee Support

 

 Respond to employee questions regarding paychecks, deductions, benefits, and payroll policies. 

 Assist employees with payroll forms and required documentation. 

 Communicate professionally and maintain positive employee relationships. 



Reporting & Administrative Support

 

 Generate payroll reports for management review. 

 Assist with payroll budgeting and labor tracking. 

 Monitor overtime trends and identify payroll-related concerns. 

 Coordinate with HR regarding new hires, terminations, and employee status changes. 

 Assist with administrative tasks and special projects as assigned. 

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

 

 High School Diploma or GED required. 

 Associate degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources, Finance, or related field preferred. 



Experience

 

 Minimum 1–2 years of payroll experience preferred. 

 Experience with payroll software systems (Paychex, Gusto, ADP, QuickBooks Payroll, or similar systems preferred). 

 Experience in healthcare, home care, staffing, or service industries preferred. 



Knowledge & Skills

 

 Strong understanding of payroll processes and wage regulations. 

 Knowledge of overtime calculations and labor compliance requirements. 

 Strong attention to detail and accuracy. 

 Strong organizational and time management skills. 

 Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism. 

 Strong communication and customer service skills. 

 Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines. 

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and payroll systems. 

Physical Requirements 

 Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods. 

 Ability to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds. 

 Ability to perform repetitive hand and keyboard movements. 

Preferred Characteristics 

 Reliable and highly organized. 

 Strong problem-solving skills. 

 Detail-oriented and proactive. 

 Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments. 

 Professional and positive attitude. 

 Flexible and adaptable in a fast-paced environment. 

Scheduling & Labor Management  

 Collaborate closely with the Scheduler and Operations team to monitor staffing hours and labor utilization. 

 Assist in identifying potential overtime situations and proactively communicate scheduling concerns. 

 Review employee hours and work patterns to help minimize unnecessary overtime while maintaining adequate client coverage and continuity of care. 

 Support schedule adjustments and staffing recommendations to improve efficiency and control labor costs. 

 Monitor trends related to overtime, missed shifts, and scheduling patterns and report concerns to management. 

 

Performance Expectations / KPIs

 

 Payroll processed accurately and on time. 

 Payroll error rate maintained below 1%. 

 Timesheet discrepancies resolved within designated deadlines. 

 Overtime hours monitored and reduced through proactive collaboration with scheduling staff. 

 Employee payroll concerns addressed promptly. 

 Compliance maintained with payroll regulations and company standards.



To Apply

Send your resume and a voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining your experience, your speed of wifi,  Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Reply with the word MONTBONITA to show you read this posting in full.

title: SEO & Authority Content Lead
description:
What ranks in two years matters more than what publishes this week.



A short pitch for who this is:



You play the long game. You've watched a single well-built piece quietly drive traffic for years. You've also watched companies torch their search presence by pumping out AI-generated noise because someone read a thread about content velocity.



You don't confuse output with strategy.



You can pull up a SERP and explain, page by page, what each ranking result is doing well and where the gap is. You think most "SEO advice" online is recycled and shallow, and you can argue why.



ABOUT SGEN



SGEN doesn't yet have authority in search.



Somebody Googling "WordPress alternative for agencies" in 2027 should land on a SGEN piece that's actually useful — not keyword bait.



Somebody Googling "why Elementor sites are slow" should find a piece that explains the cause honestly and only mentions SGEN where the mention earns it.



Somebody Googling "headless vs full-stack CMS" should find a comparison that reads like it was written by someone who's built both.



That's the work — building the search-and-authority layer that compounds over years, not months.



WHO FITS



You've done patient SEO before. The kind that takes 9–12 months to show its full effect and then stays for years.



You know the difference between a topic cluster and a content calendar.



You can talk through search intent, internal linking, and E-E-A-T without sounding like you got it off a
 thread.



You treat Ahrefs and Semrush as inputs, not gospel.



You can read three paragraphs of a piece and tell whether the writer actually knows the subject.



You'd rather publish ten strong pieces a year than fifty mediocre ones.



HAVE A REAL TAKE ON CONTENT STRATEGY



You probably have strong opinions about most B2B SaaS blogs. The 5-reasons posts. The 4,000-word ultimate guides that say almost nothing. The AI-generated round-ups that age in weeks.



You can articulate why most company blogs underperform: too much volume, too little point of view, no internal-link architecture, no respect for the reader's time.



You believe quality compounds and volume decays — and you can back it with examples from work you've done.



STEADY THROUGH SLOW MONTHS



Some pieces won't rank for months. Some will spike at six. Some will get quietly large a year after publishing.



You don't panic at month-one numbers. You don't pivot the strategy after one flop. You measure, wait, revise, re-link, and let the work do its job.



Search authority is a long conversation. You're comfortable in long conversations.



THE ACTUAL WORK



Topic strategy. Map the keyword and concept universe SGEN should own — WordPress alternatives, modern CMS, agency tooling, hosting-plus-builder-plus-CMS as one platform. Cluster it. Sequence it. Build a 12-month plan, not a 30-day calendar.



Long-form pieces. Write or commission the deep posts — pillar articles, honest comparisons, technical explainers, opinion-led essays. The ones that get cited, linked to, and quoted in newsletters. Voice support from Jerome; distribution support from the Growth Marketer.



Comparison pages. SGEN vs. WordPress. SGEN vs. Webflow. SGEN vs. Framer. SGEN vs. Squarespace. Real comparisons that acknowledge where SGEN isn't the right answer. That honesty is what makes the rest of the page credible.



Internal architecture. Design how the content links to itself. Keep the structure clean. Prevent the sprawl that wrecks most company blogs after year two.



Editorial bar. Set the quality standard for the blog and enforce it. Lighter, faster posts from the Growth Marketer are welcome on their own lane; the authority pieces all run through you.



Measurement. Organic traffic by cluster, rank position on target queries, organic backlinks, pieces that worked and didn't. Monthly read-out, honest, no vanity metrics.



WHAT WE’RE CHECKING FOR



- A portfolio with rankings. Pieces you wrote that ranked or drove traffic. If you can talk through why they worked, even better.



- English that reads native. Long pieces have to hold the reader. Every paragraph earns its place.



- WordPress and adjacent-CMS literacy. You don't need to be a developer. You need enough fluency in the ecosystem — plugins, builders, hosts, the actual pain — to write about it credibly. Webflow, Framer, Ghost, Shopify experience is a plus.



- SEO that isn't tricks. Topic clusters, intent, internal linking, durable on-page. You can also explain why most public SEO advice is shallow.



- A track record of compounding work. A small number of pieces still driving traffic years after publishing beats a large number that stopped working in three months.



- Sustainable cadence. One serious piece every two weeks, at this length, at this depth. Not faster. Not slower.



PROBABLY YOU IF



- You can name three SaaS blogs you respect and three you consider noise — with reasoning for each.

- You've personally written a piece still ranking a year later.

- You've watched a content program fail because somebody confused "publish more" with "build authority."

- You've rewritten an old post and watched its traffic multiply.

- You think most AI content is going to age poorly, and you can say why.

- You enjoy reading SERPs.



WHAT THIS ISN’T



It isn't a content mill.



It isn't four AI-assisted posts a week.



It isn't repackaging the docs as blog posts.



It isn't competitor comparisons where SGEN always wins.



It's a long-horizon search strategy run by somebody who's done it before and has the receipts.



WHY IT MATTERS



Search is the most durable acquisition channel a software company has access to.



Communities shift. Algorithms change. Ads get expensive.



A piece that ranks on a high-intent query, with real depth and an honest point of view, keeps working for years.



The right hire here plants the pieces that quietly carry SGEN's growth long after they shipped. The wrong hire here publishes volume that ranks for nothing.



COMPENSATION

$600-$650 USD per month



SCHEDULE

- 8 hour shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00AM to 4:00PM Philippine Time.

- Minimal overtime during weekdays and weekends will be expected as part of salary

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other basis protected by law.

title: Virtual Assistant Video Editor for Sleeping YouTube Channel (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
## About the role



We’re hiring a Virtual Assistant (VA) Video Editor to produce daily content for multiple sleeping/relaxation YouTube channels. The work is simple and repetitive, but it requires consistency, attention to detail, and the ability to use AI tools to create content quickly at scale. This is a monthly, long-term position for someone who wants stable work and is willing to learn and improve the workflow over time. 





## What you’ll be creating each day



You will produce 10 long-form videos per day, each 1 to 3 hours long. The editing style is intentionally minimal and follows a repeatable template. 



Each video includes:

1. Intro section: 5 short AI-generated video clips plus a short/long voiceover segment. 

2. Main section (rest of the video): mostly static or slowly changing images with background music/voiceover only.



You’ll use AI tools (accounts provided) to generate visuals and support production:

1. Veo3 & Nano Banana (GenAI)

2. Leonardo AI for generating images (Secondary Option)





## Responsibilities



In this role, you will:

- Edit and export 10 sleeping/relaxation videos daily (1–3 hours each). 

- Use the provided GenAI tools/accounts to generate the 5 intro clips and create/source images for the remainder of each video. 

- Add a short voiceover at the beginning/long voiceover for some historic videos (we will provide the voiceover with script). 

- Add music + images only for the rest of the video. For some videos, voiceover for the entire video.

- Follow a consistent, simple template across all videos to maintain uniform style and quality. 

- Take notes and help streamline the workflow over time to improve speed, organization, and consistency. 

- Communicate regularly about progress, bottlenecks, and ideas to make the process faster and smoother. 





## Requirements



To be successful, you should have:

- Basic video editing experience (any software is fine as long as you can export stable 1–3 hour videos). 

- A stable internet connection and a computer capable of exporting long videos. 

- Comfort using AI tools—or willingness to learn quickly—especially Veo3 / Nano Banana (GenAI) and Leonardo AI. 

- Availability to work at least 6 days per week. 

- The ability to handle repetitive tasks while consistently following a clear template. 

- Strong attention to detail, organization, and a proactive mindset. 

- Willingness to take notes, create checklists, and improve the process over time. 

- Good English communication skills. 





## Bonus (nice to have)



Not required, but helpful:

- Experience with YouTube content—especially sleeping, relaxing, meditation, or ambience channels. 

- Experience as a VA for content creators. 

- Familiarity with royalty-free music and basic copyright rules to keep content YouTube-safe. 



## Salary & benefits



* Monthly salary is $400-$500 based on quality and speed(we will start off with $400, then we will increase based on the performance).

* Long-term, stable role if performance is consistent. 

* Opportunity to grow with the channel and take on more responsibilities over time. 



If you enjoy calm, repetitive work and like improving systems for faster output over time, this role is a strong fit.

title: Junior Automation Specialist
description:

mbers in Slack

-Document new builds. Each new automation ships with a build guide so it's not Automation Specialist's knowledge.

-Respond to finance team Slack queries. Automation Specialist still owns the strategic conversations; junior handles routine tactical follow-ups.

Must-haves:

title: Master Transactor (Transaction Coordinator ++)
description:
About us

Build Vacations is a U.S.-based short-term rental development company. We partner with investors to acquire, develop, and operate exceptional vacation properties — and we believe that every detail of that process matters.



We're a small, tight-knit team that values radical candor, personal growth, and shared success. We use AI tools as a core part of our workflow, and we move fast — which means we need someone precise, proactive, and extremely organized. Don't worry about the AI, we will teach you.



The role

You will be the central document control point for the company — tracking, organizing, and managing documentation for every real estate transaction, development project, and corporate record we touch. This is not a passive filing role. You will coordinate deadlines, chase missing documents, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks across acquisitions, financing, permitting, and construction.



If you are the kind of person who gets genuine satisfaction from a perfectly organized folder system and a checklist with every box checked, this role was built for you.



What you'll own

Coordinating purchase, sale, and financing transactions from contract through closing

Managing escrow and title documentation, tracking closing timelines, and coordinating with brokers, attorneys, lenders, and title companies

Maintaining transaction checklists with disciplined naming conventions and version control

Organizing development and permitting documents, tracking submission and approval timelines

Sorting and routing documents into appropriate AI tools and knowledge systems (Google Drive, NotebookLM, Claude, etc.)

Managing corporate records: LLC documents, operating agreements, annual filings, investment agreements

Proactively identifying missing documentation before deadlines hit — never waiting to be asked

You're a great fit if you...

Have 2–5+ years in real estate transaction coordination, paralegal work, or document management

Can recognize and immediately understand documents like purchase agreements, title commitments, closing statements, escrow instructions, and loan origination documents

Are comfortable working in Google Drive, DocuSign, PDF editing tools, and spreadsheet tracking

Have used or are genuinely curious about AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, NotebookLM, or similar)

Communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish

Are energized by process, routine, and precision — not overwhelmed by it

This role is not for you if...

You prefer to improvise your organization systems or "figure it out as you go"

You wait for someone to tell you what's missing instead of hunting it down yourself

Detailed document tracking feels tedious rather than satisfying

Application screening — please read carefully

We review every application that follows these instructions completely. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Loom video — 2 to 6 minutes

Record a Loom video (
 — free to use) and paste the link in your application. Address all five questions below in order. We will not watch videos longer than 6 minutes.



1. Walk us through how you organize digital documents for a real estate transaction.

What system do you use, and why? Be specific about naming conventions, folder structure, or tools.

2. Describe a time you caught a missing document or deadline before it became a problem.

What did you notice, what did you do, and what was the outcome?

3. In your own words, explain the purpose of each of these five documents:

Title Commitment · Escrow Instructions · Closing Disclosure · Operating Agreement · Construction Draw Request. Speak from experience — do not read definitions.

4. How do you use AI tools to manage transactions better?

Tell us which tools you've used (Claude, ChatGPT, NotebookLM, or others), how you've applied them to real estate or document workflows, and what worked — or didn't.

5. Read this phrase aloud at some point during your video:

"Build Vacations — details matter, deposits follow."

We are not looking for a perfect video. We are looking for clear thinking, calm communication, and someone who follows instructions precisely.

Submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line: Master Transactor — [Your Name]

title: Real Estate Social Media Content Manager/Editor
description:
This is a part time position with the potential for full-time within six months. PERFORMANCE BASED BONUSES AS WELL!



This role is specifically a content manager for a real estate team in the Florida Panhandle. Our YouTube channel is our primary lead generation engine, targeting families, veterans, and professionals making long-distance moves to the area. It is ran by two of the agents on the team. We want to move into Instagram and grow our social media presence. We have an AI system built and the content generated, we need someone to manage and help us post/create the short form video, etc.



On our channel, we publish long-form educational videos that are data-heavy and conversational. Our audience comes to us for honest local expertise, and our content reflects that. We have a defined brand voice and visual style that this role is expected to match exactly.



This is a content management role, not just a clipping job. You’ll own four interconnected pipelines — long-form video production, short-form distribution, AI-assisted content operations, and multi-platform social publishing. A typical week spans all four, a typical day three out of four mostly.

 

Long-Form Video Production

•     Publish finished videos to YouTube with fully optimized metadata: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, and thumbnails

•     Track video performance in YouTube Studio and report key metrics (views, watch time, CTR, subscriber impact) on a weekly basis

•.    Our videos are edited by a third party who will provide the completed video and thumnail. We post every four days. You will not be required to edit long form content.

 

Short-Form Content (YouTube Shorts, Reels)

•     Identify and cut the highest-value clips from long-form YouTube videos for distribution as Shorts and Reels.

•     Apply SEO best practices to every short: hooks, captions, hashtags, and platform-specific formatting

•     Schedule and publish across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and
 Reels

•     Monitor short-form performance metrics and flag what’s working for content strategy discussions

•.    Cut and Edit 5-7 raw short form videos for Instagram Reels every week. This will be a preponderance of your duties. We          

       have the content machine already built--we record, we drop in a folder, you edit according to our brand guide, you post.

 

AI Content Operations (Claude AI)

•     Manage and operate our Claude AI content workflow — we call it our Content Machine — to generate written content from video scripts and research

•     Convert AI-generated output into polished, publish-ready blog posts formatted for our Google Business Profile pages

•     Maintain consistency between written blog content and the corresponding video — same data, same voice, same accuracy standards

•      Post Polished AI Content across 3-5 Google My Business Pages (Depending on which content). 

 

Multi-Platform Social Media Management

•     Manage content publishing and scheduling across LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube, and Google My Business

•     Adapt content format and copy for each platform — what works on YouTube doesn’t always land the same on LinkedIn or other platforms.

•     Maintain the content calendar and upload tracker in Google Sheets. Provide weekly updates on specific data metrics.

•     Communicate daily progress via WhatsApp and report to the Executive Team weekly with data metrics and updated channel metrics

 

What We’re Looking For

Skills and demonstrated output matter more to us than niche background — you don’t need real estate experience to thrive, but it is an added bonus. But this is a multi-discipline role, and we need someone who can operate across video, SEO, AI tools, and social media without fail.

 

•     Proven experience editing short-form video content — show us your work

•     YouTube SEO: keyword research, title writing, descriptions, tags, and chapter markers...a willingness to learn our niche and apply everything.

•     Comfortable working inside YouTube Studio end-to-end: uploading, scheduling, metadata, and analytics

•     Experience managing or publishing content across LinkedIn,
, Instagram and Google Business pages.

•     Comfortable working with AI writing tools (Claude AI or similar) to produce and refine written content

•     Ability to write clean, clear English for blog posts, descriptions, and social captions — no fluff, no filler

•     Detail-oriented and process-driven — you’ll follow a defined style guide, not freelance the brand. All the brand guides and

•     Self-managed and reliable — async work means we’re trusting your output without daily oversight

•     Proficient with Google Drive and Google Sheets for file management and performance tracking

•     Available for at least 4–6 hours of overlap with US Central Timezones.

 

Tools You’ll Work With

•     YouTube Studio — upload management, scheduling, analytics

•     Taja.AI — AI-assisted YouTube SEO (we’ll provide access)

•     TubeBuddy — keyword research and SEO scoring (we’ll provide access)

•     Claude AI — content and description drafting

•     Google Drive & Google Sheets — file storage and content tracker

•     WhatsApp — day-to-day communication

•     Your own editing software — CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or equivalent (whatever you are comfortable with, we will get for you)

•     Go High Level - For Scheduled Content Posting -- We can teach this if you are not familiar. 

 

How to Apply



We read every application personally and move quickly on the right fit. All application materials go to 
 applications will not be reviewed. All applications must be sent via
--applications submitted on the Onlinejobs.ph platform will not be reviewed. 

 

Only
 submissions will be reviewed. Send the following in your
:

 

SUBJECT LINE: CONTENT IS MORE IMPORTANT (It's must be in all Caps):



•     Your resume.

•     2–3 examples of content you’ve edited — long-form or short-form (YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok links preferred).

•     A video introduction — 30 seconds to 1.5 minutes. Tell us who you are and why you want this role. We’re looking for personality and communication, not production value.

•     A completed BMG DISC Profile – Completely filled out including name and date

 

All additional hiring materials — including the DISC assessment — are available in our hiring folder:

 





Our Hiring Process

 

1.  Application Review — We review every
 submission. Submissions within the online jobs platform will be replied to and deleted.. If your background and DISC test are a fit, you’ll hear from us within a few business days.

2.  Group Interview — A short video call with our lead executive assistant. No tricks — we just want to meet you and answer your questions.

3.  Performance Test — We’ll send you one raw video clip and ask you to edit it to our style guide. This is the most important step.

4.  Individual Interview — Final one-on-one conversation before we extend an offer.



One more thing — and this matters. The subject line of your
 must read exactly as follows: CONTENT IS MORE IMPORTANT. All caps. No exceptions. This tells us you read everything, followed the process, and pay attention to details. It’s a small thing that makes a big difference to us.

title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT - Finance & Operations Focused
description:
About NordStick



NordStick is a leading fitness brand founded in 2020 by a prominent physical therapist, dedicated to innovative home based workout solutions that help people overcome pain, prevent injuries, and achieve peak performance. Our flagship products, like the NordStick and NordBench Pro, are affordable, high quality, and multifunctional, empowering over 250,000 customers to build strength and improve mobility without a gym. As part of a fast growing DTC fitness ecosystem, we're committed to making health and wellness accessible. This is not a lifestyle brand. It is a long term company with high expectations around execution, ownership, and reliability.



The Role



We are hiring a Finance and Operations Focused Executive Assistant to support the Founder and keep the business running cleanly behind the scenes.



This is not bookkeeping or simple admin work.



You are responsible for making sure numbers match, processes are organized, vendors are handled, and operational details do not fall apart.



If something is messy, unclear, or late, you fix it.



If you prefer waiting for step by step instructions, this role will feel painful. If you naturally bring order to chaos, you will thrive.



Approximately 50% of your time will support customer service and operational tasks, with the rest focused on finance tracking, reporting, and systems.



Core Responsibilities



Execution Support and Ownership

--> Support the Founder across operational and financial initiatives

 --> Track priorities, deadlines, and dependencies across teams

 --> Follow up on deliverables and ensure nothing slips

 --> Turn direction into clear tasks and timelines



Finance and Data Management

--> Maintain and update Google Sheets for sales, expenses, inventory, and reporting

 --> Reconcile data across platforms to ensure numbers are accurate

 --> Track payouts, invoices, and vendor payments

 --> Assist with financial reporting and performance analysis

 --> Flag inconsistencies or risks before they become problems



Operations and Systems

--> Support Shopify operations and order workflows

 --> Help test and validate the full customer journey from purchase to fulfillment

 --> Assist with customer service platforms like Rich Panel

 --> Document processes and create simple SOPs

 --> Use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency



Communication and Coordination

--> Coordinate with vendors, partners, and internal teams

 --> Prepare agendas and notes for check ins

 --> Keep communication tight, clear, and actionable

 --> Act as a central point of coordination across operations



What Success Looks Like



Within 30 Days

--> Reports and trackers are organized and accurate

 --> No preventable operational delays

 --> Founder is not chasing basic financial or CS details



Within 90 Days

--> Numbers are reliable and easy to understand

 --> Operations feel smooth and predictable

 --> Issues are caught early, not after damage is done

 --> Leadership focuses on growth, not fixing avoidable mistakes



Requirements

You should not apply unless most of the following are true:

--> You have supported operations, finance, or backend business functions before

 --> You are highly organized and detail obsessed

 --> You are comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets daily

 --> You take ownership and solve problems independently

 --> You communicate clearly and directly

 --> You have experience with Google Sheets and ecommerce tools like Shopify

 --> You are comfortable learning new systems quickly

 --> You can commit full time, working 40 hours per week



How to Apply

Send a message with:

--> Your resume

 --> A brief overview of why you are a strong fit for this role

title: Traffic Management Planner (NZ Client)
description:
Job Brief 



We are seeking a highly analytical and safety-focused remote professional to support the development and documentation of robust traffic management plans for civil and infrastructure projects. This role is responsible for bridging the gap between permanent engineering designs and temporary site safety, ensuring all Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) are meticulously prepared, risk-assessed, and compliant with industry safety standards. 



You will play a critical role in minimising on-site hazards, protecting both the workforce and the public, and supporting the seamless execution of traffic management operations across multiple projects. 



Responsibilities 

Traffic Management Planning: Author and develop comprehensive Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) that effectively translate permanent road design principles into safe and compliant temporary traffic management strategies. 

Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify site hazards and utilise 5x5 risk matrices to evaluate residual risks, ensuring all planning documentation satisfies strict safety and compliance requirements. 

Compliance Management: Maintain alignment with ISO principles and health and safety frameworks to ensure all documentation adheres to legislative and regulatory standards. 

Technical Software Utilisation: Use specialised traffic management and CAD-based software to produce accurate traffic routing plans, site layouts, and operational diagrams. 

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, operations, and project teams to ensure the practicality and operational feasibility of traffic management plans, updating documentation as project requirements evolve. 



Requirements 

Proven understanding of risk management frameworks, including hazard identification, 5x5 risk matrices, and residual risk evaluation.  

Strong familiarity with ISO principles or structured health and safety management systems.  

Prior experience in civil roading, traffic engineering, construction planning, or a related field.  

Ability to apply permanent road design principles within temporary traffic management environments.  

Strong computer literacy with the ability to quickly learn specialised technical planning software.  

High attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate, audit-ready technical documentation.  

Strong written and verbal English communication skills aligned with New Zealand professional standards.  

Experience with CAD or AutoCAD is highly advantageous, though not essential.  

Understanding of Austroads principles   

Proven experience in Traffic management plan design in New Zealand under the NZGTTM 



Software Proficiency 

Traffic Management Software – Rapid Plan or equivalent CAD-based traffic management platforms 

Design Software – AutoCAD or standard CAD software (preferred) 

Productivity Tools – Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Geodetic Engineering, or a related field. 

Relevant Associate Degree or Advanced Diploma in Engineering Technology will also be considered. 



Personal Attributes 

Highly analytical with a systematic and methodical approach to problem-solving and risk evaluation.  

Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to health, safety, and operational quality.  

Adaptable learner capable of quickly mastering new software systems, technical tools, and industry regulations.  

Reliable and accountable, with strong ownership of documentation accuracy and project deadlines.  

Professional communicator who can clearly articulate risk factors, planning requirements, and compliance standards. 



Time Zone: New Zealand Business Hours 



Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

description:
You are the person who turns a lead list into a booked meeting. It all starts with the outreach that you send. Your job is to get  in front of the right people.

, LinkedIn and any other platform that you need to use for effectiveness. You will write compelling, direct outreach messages, manage follow-up sequences, and book qualified discovery calls directly onto our closer’s calendar. You are not sending mass spam, but sending targeted, personalized messages that start real conversations.



We provide you with the tools you need to execute outreach at scale: Smartlead; for cold
 campaign management, sequencing, and deliverability, and Go High Level for scheduling directly from outreach links. You must be able to prove proficiency with these tools within the first 30 days. 



Within your first week, you will have your first campaign live. It is vital that you demonstrate consistent meeting bookings from your outreach. You must show measurable results such as replies, conversations, and booked calls. I want you to be irreplaceable. 



Experience running cold
 or any type of outreach campaign is a plus. You must have strong written English because your messages represent the business. You must have an understanding of follow-up sequences and reply handling. Available 40 hrs/week, and then 60 hour weeks within a salary role after high performance over time. 



Compensation & Growth: Starting rate is $3/hr during the training period, and the length of this training is dictated by you. If you prove that you only need a week of level 1 training, then your pay will be doubled at that time. In the level 2 training period your rate is $6 an hour, and when you are consistently booking qualified meetings onto the calendar and running full campaigns independently with strong booking rates, you move to $12 an hour. After becoming an indispensable asset, you will be given a salary of $3000/monthly. Your pay is tied directly to highly qualified meetings booked.

title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:

This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

title: EXPERIENCED EA / PA TO CEO - FULL-TIME - AUSTRALIAN
description:
OPENING STATEMENT



We are an established Australian construction and technology consultancy looking for a full-time Personal Assistant / Executive Assistant to support our CEO and Director.



The work involves managing calendars, booking travel, coordinating client onboarding, maintaining compliance and insurance trackers, chasing follow-ups, and handling day-to-day admin across both personal and business tasks. You will be expected to take ownership of outcomes and drive tasks through to completion - not just send one
 and wait.



If you have worked as an EA or PA supporting a busy executive, or you have a background in operations admin, travel coordination, or project admin in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.



30,000php starting salary during probation. 33,500php + 1,500php benefits post probation (~1 month). Salary is negotiable for a high-calibre candidate who can clearly demonstrate strong EA/PA experience, excellent English, and the ability to take ownership without constant supervision.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Stable, long-term role with an Australian business

* Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

* 30,000php starting salary during probation. 33,500php + 1,500php benefits post probation (~1month)

* Fully remote - work from home

* Full training on all tools and systems

* 13th month pay and government-mandated benefits



WHAT YOU'LL DO (TRAINING PROVIDED)



* Manage the CEO's calendar, scheduling, and inbox across business and personal commitments

* Book and coordinate travel for the CEO, family, and staff - flights, accommodation, and itineraries

* Handle ad hoc personal and business errands - vehicle registration, insurance paperwork, appointments

* Prepare meeting agendas, take notes, and actively chase action items through to completion

* Set up new client contracts using templates, send via DocuSign, and coordinate onboarding documentation

* Set up new clients and projects in Trello and Everhour

* Track insurance, registrations, and compliance items across company assets

* Chase invoices, receipts, and support monthly credit card reconciliation (light admin, not accounting)

* Organise team events, book meeting rooms, and maintain business documents

* Update trackers and collate inputs for reporting as directed



REQUIREMENTS



* Previous experience as an EA, PA, or in a similar admin support role

* Strong proficiency in the Microsoft Suite - this is the core platform for all work

* Proven initiative and follow-through - you take tasks and drive them to completion without needing to be prompted

* Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

* Confident enough to escalate issues, push back, and ask clarifying questions when needed

* Perfect English - written and verbal

* Comfortable in a direct, informal workplace culture where communication is blunt and unfiltered

* Reliable computer and stable internet connection



NICE TO HAVE



* Experience with DocuSign, Trello, Everhour, Xero, or Confluence

* Experience supporting multiple executives with competing priorities

* Background in travel coordination, particularly domestic Australian travel

* Experience maintaining compliance or asset registers



SCHEDULE



* Full-time, 40 hours per week

* Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

* Australian timezone (AEST/AEDT)

* Occasional weekend or after-hours availability for urgent matters



If you have real EA or PA experience, can work independently, and want a long-term role where initiative and follow-through are genuinely valued - apply now.



HOW TO APPLY



* Click "APPLY FOR THIS JOB" button on this job post.

* Optionally, you may write a message.

* Click Send
.

 from us with the next steps and instructions for the hiring process.

title: Systems Monitoring & Account Maintenance VA
description:
JOB TITLE

Systems Monitoring & Account Maintenance VA



---



JOB DESCRIPTION



An established Australian business is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA to take over daily monitoring and maintenance of multiple systems and accounts.



This is not a standard Monday-Friday role. The work runs every single day, including weekends, and requires consistency and discipline. The same core tasks must be completed daily to a high standard, without drop-off in accuracy or focus.



Your core work will involve logging into remote machines each day, checking that everything is running correctly, restarting anything that has stopped, recording account balances in a spreadsheet, flagging unusual activity, and carrying out small maintenance actions as directed. The work is repetitive, detail-critical, and must be executed consistently every day.



If you have experience in operations monitoring, account management, IT helpdesk, data entry, or any role where you were responsible for checking systems, recording information accurately, and keeping things running smoothly on a daily basis, this role will suit you well.



---



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time position, 40 hours per week

* Stable, long-term role with an Australian business

* 20,000php starting salary during probation

* 23,500php + 1,500php benefits post probation (~1 month)

* KPI-based performance bonuses after approximately 3 months

* 13th month pay and government-mandated benefits

* Full training provided through screen-recorded sessions

* Fully remote - work from home

* Genuine scope for role growth into financial admin over time



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO (TRAINING PROVIDED)



* Log into multiple remote machines daily and confirm everything is running correctly

* Restart software or machines that have stopped and ensure all systems are operational

* Record account balances accurately in a spreadsheet

* Review recent activity and flag anything unusual

* Carry out small maintenance actions as directed

* After 2-3 months, produce daily summaries of accounts needing attention and take on additional reporting tasks



---



REQUIREMENTS



* Strong attention to detail - accurate balance recording across many accounts is the core of this role and mistakes have direct consequences

* Comfortable with REPETITIVE, ROUTINE WORK performed to a high standard every single day

* AVAILABLE TO WORK 7 DAYS A WEEK, with days off taken Monday to Wednesday if needed

* Able to maintain focus and consistency even on weekends or quieter shifts

* Able to follow instructions from screen-recorded training sessions, take your own notes, and execute independently without needing things re-explained

* Willing to speak up immediately when something is unclear rather than guessing

* Comfortable learning and working inside remote desktop and browser-based software daily

* Reliable internet connection and computer setup



---



NICE TO HAVE



* Experience with account management or similar monitoring roles

* Experience with remote desktop tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Chrome Remote Desktop)

* Experience with multi-profile browsers or similar tools

* Background in IT support, helpdesk, or systems monitoring



---



SCHEDULE



* Full-time, 40 hours per week

* 7 days per week (days off Monday to Wednesday if needed)

* Core hours: 11:00am to 4:00p
lbourne time (AEST/AEDT)

* Australian timezone (AEST/AEDT)



---



This role suits someone who takes pride in doing the same job well every day, pays close attention to detail even on routine tasks, and is specifically looking for a structured, DAILY WORKLOAD rather than a standard weekday-only job. If that sounds like you - apply now.

description:

COMMERCIAL LENDING ADMIN VA

We are an Australian commercial funding business based on the east coast of Australia. We match borrowers - builders, developers, landowners, and commercial property owners - with private investors and institutional lenders. We are hiring a full-time Commercial Lending Admin VA to take over the administrative side of our operations.



Your day-to-day work will involve setting up and managing document data rooms in Google Drive for each deal, collecting and organising all required documents from clients, following up when documents are overdue, managing diaries, and handling general admin tasks across all active deals. You will be building the filing and document management system from scratch - there is no existing CRM or structured process in place.



If you have experience in finance administration, credit file processing, loan administration, compliance document management, or similar roles where you were responsible for collecting, organising, and tracking documents across multiple matters or cases, we want to hear from you.

s, and deal records

title: BUSINESS OPERATIONS & SYSTEMS ORGANISER
description:
JOB TITLE

BUSINESS OPERATIONS & SYSTEMS ORGANISER



==================================================



JOB DESCRIPTION

An established Australian business is looking for a full-time Business Operations & Systems Organiser to help build the financial tracking, reporting, and organisational systems the business needs as it grows. This is a role with real responsibility - you will work closely with the business owner to design and maintain the tools that give them a clear view of their numbers at all times.



The business already has one VA handling day-to-day operations. This role works alongside them but focuses on a different layer - expense tracking, bookkeeping, reporting, and keeping things organised behind the scenes. You will work directly with the business owner to understand what data matters, build practical systems to capture it, and keep everything running smoothly.



If you enjoy turning messy problems into clean, working systems and you like having the space to figure things out - you will do well here.



---



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time, long-term position (40 hours per week)

* Stable role with an established Australian business

* PHP 33,500 starting salary, increasing to PHP 35,000 after probation

* 13th month pay and government-mandated benefits

* Fully remote - work from home

* Casual, supportive working environment with a direct and approachable business owner

* Real ownership and autonomy - you build the systems, not just maintain them



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



* Build and maintain financial tracking systems (Airtable, Google Sheets, or similar) that link income and expenses to individual accounts

* Record operational costs and track profitability at the account level

* Track total funds across accounts and pending withdrawals so the business owner always has a clear cash position

* Manage bookkeeping in Xero, including regular reconciliation

* Produce weekly reports covering balances, expenses, profit per account, and account purchasing trends

* Spot and raise anything that looks off in the numbers early, so small issues don't become big ones

* Design and build new tracking or reporting systems as needs come up, using AI tools where they help

* Help the business owner stay on top of their week - following up on pending items, flagging deadlines, and keeping things structured

* Coordinate with the first VA where workflows connect, particularly around transaction data



---



REQUIREMENTS



* Comfortable working with numbers - you do not need to be an accountant, but financial data should feel natural to you

* Confident with spreadsheets and data tools (Airtable, Google Sheets, or similar) - you have built trackers or structured systems before

* Comfortable with Xero or happy to learn it - bookkeeping will be a regular part of the role and we will support you getting up to speed

* A natural self-starter - you are the kind of person who looks for what needs doing and gets on with it, asking questions along the way

* Strong written and spoken English - you will write reports and summaries, and communicate daily via 

* Already using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in your work - even in simple ways, as long as it is part of how you actually get things done

* Happy working in a role that will evolve over time - the systems are still being built, and that is part of what makes this role interesting

* Reliable computer and stable internet connection



---



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



* Prior bookkeeping or accounting experience

* Familiarity with Airtable, including views, formulas, and linked records

* Experience building operational dashboards or reporting systems

* Background in a data-driven business (e-commerce, trading, finance, or similar)



---



SCHEDULE



* Full-time, 40 hours per week

* Australian daytime hours (approximately 10am - 6pm AEST)

* Daily communication via 



==================================================
